passive.name: Granite Shield
passive.description: Malphite is shielded by a layer of rock which absorbs damage up to 10% of his maximum Health. If Malphite has not been hit for a few seconds, this effect recharges.

primaryAbilities.name: Seismic Shard
primaryAbilities.description: Malphite sends a shard of the earth through the ground at his foe, dealing damage upon impact and stealing Move Speed for 3 seconds.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Malphite launches a shard of earth at an enemy, dealing <magicDamage>{{ qdamagecalc }} magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Slowing</status> them by {{ speedsteal }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds. Malphite also steals the amount <status>Slowed</status>, gaining it as <speed>Move Speed</speed> for {{ slowduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Thunderclap
primaryAbilities.description: Malphite attacks with such force that it creates a sonic boom. For the next few seconds, his attacks create aftershocks in front of him.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Passive: Malphite gains {{ bonusarmorpassive*100 }}% Armor (%i:scaleArmor%{{ f1 }}). This effect is increased to {{ bonusarmorpassive*300 }}% (%i:scaleArmor%{{ f2 }}) while Granite Shield is active.

Active: Malphite's next Attack deals an additional {{ totalbonusdamage }} physical damage and creates an aftershock which deals {{ thunderclapsplash }} physical damage %i:OnHit% On-Hit in their direction. His Attacks continue to create aftershocks %i:OnHit% On-Hit for the next {{ thunderclapbuffduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Ground Slam
primaryAbilities.description: Malphite slams the ground, sending out a shockwave that deals magic damage based on his Armor and reduces the Attack Speed of enemies for a short duration.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Malphite slams the ground, dealing <magicDamage>{{ edamagecalc }} magic damage</magicDamage> and reducing <attackSpeed>Attack Speed by {{ asreduction }}%</attackSpeed> for {{ duration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Unstoppable Force
primaryAbilities.description: Malphite launches himself to a location at high speed, damaging enemies and knocking them into the air.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Malphite charges with the force of a landslide, dashing Unstoppably. At the end of the dash, Malphite <status>Knocks Up</status> for {{ knockupduration }} seconds and deals <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}
